edges.reason: transfer delegates token movement to the internal _transfer routine
transferFrom delegates token movement to _transfer
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve
approve writes the allowance through _approve
_transfer finalizes the operation through _tokenTransfer
_transfer can trigger swapAndLiquify before the state settles
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferFromExcluded when only the sender is excluded
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferToExcluded when only the recipient is excluded
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard for normal accounts
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferBothExcluded when both parties are excluded
_transferStandard derives all amounts from _getValues
_transferStandard takes the liquidity portion via _takeLiquidity
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee
_transferToExcluded derives amounts from _getValues
_transferToExcluded takes liquidity via _takeLiquidity
_transferToExcluded reflects the fee via _reflectFee
_transferFromExcluded derives amounts from _getValues
_transferFromExcluded takes liquidity via _takeLiquidity
_transferFromExcluded reflects the fee via _reflectFee
_transferBothExcluded derives amounts from _getValues
_transferBothExcluded takes liquidity via _takeLiquidity
_transferBothExcluded reflects the fee via _reflectFee
_getValues obtains t-values from _getTValues
_getValues obtains r-values from _getRValues
_getValues reads the current reflection rate from _getRate
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply
_takeLiquidity queries the current rate via _getRate
swapAndLiquify performs an external token-to-ETH swap
swapAndLiquify performs an external liquidity addition
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping
addLiquidity approves the router before adding liquidity
airdrop performs the distribution through _transfer
airdropInternal performs the distribution through _transfer
airdropArray loops calling airdropInternal
claimTokens pushes the whole ETH balance to the marketing wallet, owner-gated
clearStuckBalance forwards the contract ETH balance to an arbitrary address, owner-gated
swapAndLiquify transfers the marketing share of ETH after an external swap
swapTokensForEth invokes the router with zero minimum output
addLiquidity invokes the router with zero slippage bounds
unlock reassigns the owner through an unguarded ownership change
_taxFee feeds the tax computation inside _getTValues
_liquidityFee feeds the liquidity computation inside _getTValues
_rTotal is the dividend used when computing the reflection rate
_tTotal is the divisor used when computing the reflection rate
_rTotal is decremented while computing the current rSupply
_tTotal is decremented while computing the current tSupply
_rOwned balances are debited and credited in _transferStandard
_tOwned balances are adjusted in _transferFromExcluded
_allowances is written by _approve
_isExcludedFromFee determines whether a transfer takes fees
_maxTxAmount caps the transfer amount in _transfer
_maxWalletSize caps the recipient balance in _transfer
numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity is the swap trigger threshold in _transfer
_isExcluded selects which transfer variant _tokenTransfer executes
canTrade gates transfers so that only the owner may trade before launch
botWallets can block or allow transfers for blacklisted accounts
_owner is the only account able to execute claimTokens
_previousOwner must equal msg.sender to unlock
_lockTime governs whether the timestamp lock has expired
marketingWallet receives the marketing ETH share
marketingWallet is the destination of the claimTokens balance transfer
marketingFeePercent scales the marketing share computation
swapAndLiquifyEnabled conditionally enables the automatic swap
inSwapAndLiquify guards against recursive swap execution
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from to avoid circular liquidity events
uniswapV2Router is the target of the swap call
uniswapV2Router is the target of the liquidity call
_tFeeTotal is accrued in deliver
_rTotal is reduced in deliver
_rOwned of the contract is credited with the liquidity reflection amount
_rOwned is debited for the sender in _transferFromExcluded
_tOwned participates in transfer bookkeeping alongside _transferStandard state
msg.sender is the implicit source of a transfer call
msg.sender determines the effective sender in internal transfers
msg.sender must match _previousOwner to regain ownership in unlock
msg.sender is used as owner/spender in _approve flows
block.timestamp sets the unlock deadline in lock, making the lock time miner-influenceable
block.timestamp determines whether the lock has expired in unlock
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline to the router
External router and ETH transfers inside swapAndLiquify hand control back to untrusted code during a _transfer
The amount parameter flows into the external transfer entrypoint
The from parameter drives the sender accounting in _transfer
The to parameter drives the recipient accounting in _transfer
The recipient parameter flows into the external transfer entrypoint
The sender parameter selects the transfer variant in _tokenTransfer
The recipient parameter selects the transfer variant in _tokenTransfer
The clamped contract token balance is split and swapped in swapAndLiquify
The half balance is swapped for ETH in swapAndLiquify
The other half is used for liquidity addition in swapAndLiquify
The time parameter is added to block.timestamp to set the lock deadline
The captured deployer address becomes the initial owner
The new amount parameter is scaled and stored as _maxTxAmount
The marketing share is subtracted from the swapped ETH balance in swapAndLiquify

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists to feed the external transfer entrypoint and can be folded into the transfer function node
The from parameter is local to the internal _transfer validation and accounting logic
The to parameter is local to the internal _transfer validation and accounting logic
The recipient parameter only feeds the external transfer entrypoint
The sender parameter only selects the branch executed inside _tokenTransfer
The recipient parameter only selects the branch executed inside _tokenTransfer
The contract token balance is a transient local consumed entirely by swapAndLiquify
The half value is a transient local consumed entirely by swapAndLiquify
The other half value is a transient local consumed entirely by swapAndLiquify
The time parameter only exists to compute the new lock deadline inside lock
The captured msgSender only exists during construction to seed the owner
The maxTxAmount parameter only feeds the owner-only configuration setter
The marketing share value exists solely to size the ETH transfer to the marketing wallet
